scope: Chinese technical synthesis of the author's current project principles, with public-code inspection and explicit design, implementation and validation boundaries. Documentation changes only.
principles_recorded: Logic, memory and FSM have distinct architectural responsibilities.
Preserve original memory text; the author's compressible-relation account concerns KA, EA, CA and related knowledge organization, not replacing memory originals with summaries.

The agent approach borrows the base model's existing knowledge-relation capabilities as a slice; that account is attributed to the author, not presented as a new empirical finding about model internals.
Local attention combines target original text with relevant surrounding or hierarchical index introductions and expands sources when needed; introductions do not replace originals.
Evaluate accuracy, reliability, resistance to arbitrary contamination, speed and honest unknown handling through dimension-specific differences rather than one aggregate score.
Traditional methods and baselines may be used after checking their assumptions and fit to project goals.

implementation_findings.original_input_boundary: ParagraphMemory.ingestDocument accepts JavaScript strings and uses UTF-16 code-unit offsets. Retention inside that boundary is not a guarantee about pre-ingestion decoding, OCR, transcription or arbitrary source-file bytes.
implementation_findings.summaries: Index and paragraph summaries are separate, provenance-bearing interpretation records.
implementation_findings.integration_gap: The lower paragraph module supports summary-preferred neighbors, but RecallAdapter.readOriginal currently forces raw neighbors. Automatic composition of target text with relevant upper/lower or surrounding index introductions is not claimed complete.
implementation_findings.security_boundary: Append-only protocol checks, hashes and lineage are not host-level exclusive custody, cryptographic identity authentication or truth certification.
implementation_findings.epistemic_boundary: Original retention, retrieval, local context sufficiency and final judgment require separate evidence. No end-to-end perfect fidelity or hallucination-free guarantee is claimed.

preservation.existing_documents: Only linked addenda were inserted; previous text, dated glossary compilation, historical corrections and results were retained.

validation_scope.baseline: All 276 baseline file bytes matched public Git blob identities at base_commit before editing.

offline_protocol_tests.scope: Existing Hongchenxian synthetic/double and offline-network-guard protocols only. No new behavioral or scientific validation of all principles.

validation_scope.learning_experiments: Not run; no training, new human comparison, threshold freeze or real-member operation performed.

documentation.review: Claims checked against the referenced public implementation. Existing text preserved by insertion-only addenda; all code and historical experiment bytes unchanged.

integrity.scope: Exact final candidate file-set manifest; not scientific or security certification.

release_scan.limits: Heuristic candidate-only scan, not proof of absence of every secret or rights issue.

privacy_scope: Only a paraphrased technical principles note is published. No private conversation transcript, personal identifiers, credentials, actual member memories, raw runtime logs, datasets or weights are added.
